meeting.description: Short chat on parts one and two.

note.content: Adiga's narrator is both charming and chilling. The rooster coop metaphor stayed with me.
The letter format is clever. I kept questioning how reliable Balram is.
Strong voice but the second half felt rushed to me.
The non-linear structure rewards a slow read. The river is a character.
Beautiful language. Estha and Rahel's silence hit hard.
The cognitive revolution chapter changed how I think about stories and money.
Big claims, and I wanted more sources, but a great conversation starter.
Finished in a week. The agricultural revolution as a trap is a fascinating idea.
Halfway in and hooked. The Vanger family tree needs a diagram.
Reading this for the second time and noticing far more clues.

personas.name: Reader
goals: Propose books I want to read
Keep my own notes and ratings

assumptions: One club per installation; every record still carries a club link so several clubs could be supported later
Owners and admins select books; members can only propose them
Hybrid meetings supported (virtual link and in-person location on the same meeting)
Notes are private to the member who wrote them; admins can read and remove them
Members sign in with the same email address stored on their member record
Invitees accept or decline through their own email-matched access
Email and in-app notifications only; no push or SMS
English only; times shown in the club's timezone (Asia/Kolkata)
No payments and no external calendar sync in v1
Books identified by ISBN-13 when known

requirements.text: Members can propose books; owners and admins select the next read and archive finished ones
Selecting a book records the date and notifies every member
Schedule meetings (virtual, in person or hybrid) linked to a book and view them on a calendar
Members keep their own notes and 1 to 5 star ratings per book and meeting
Invite people by email; invitees can accept or decline, and new members get a welcome email
Owners can manage everything; admins manage content and members; members read content and edit only their own notes and profile
Remind members on the day of a meeting
Show a dashboard with books read, next read, proposed books, upcoming meetings and meeting history
